results.title: Objection: "Waive my late fee / bounce charge"
results.content: Explain politely that reminder agents cannot waive or reduce charges. The request can be reviewed by the Customer Assistance team within 5 working days. Do not promise an outcome.

results.title: Late payment charge – Business Loan
results.content: Business Loan – Late payment charge: 2% per month on overdue EMI (plus GST). Last revised 2026-04-01.

results.title: Promise to pay (PTP) rules for reminder calls
results.content: A customer may commit to pay on any date up to the end of the grace period without approval. A commitment beyond the grace period must be recorded as 'PTP - beyond grace', the customer must be informed that late payment charges and bureau reporting may apply, and the case is flagged for the Customer Assistance team. Reminder agents must not waive, reduce or promise reversal of any charge. Waiver requests are reviewed only by the Customer Assistance team within 5 working days.

result.instruction: Answer ONLY from these results, briefly. If they don't answer the question, say you don't have that information.
